Article 10 — Dividends

2. Dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying them is a resident, and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

Article 11 — Interest

2. If the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, source-State tax shall not exceed 12 per cent of the gross amount. 3. Interest beneficially owned by a resident of the Czech Republic is exempt from Malaysian tax where the relevant loan or indebtedness is an approved loan under Malaysian law. 4. The Government of a Contracting State is exempt from tax in the other Contracting State in respect of qualifying interest derived by that Government.

Article 12 — Royalties

1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State. 2. Such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 12 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.
